summaries.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Besluit prudentiële regels Wft, BWBR0020420, Stb. 2006, 519, consolidated text in force from 2026-10-16

text.en: The Dutch government's decree that fills in the prudential rules of the Financial Supervision Act. It binds banks, payment and e-money institutions, investment firms, insurers and the other financial undertakings De Nederlandsche Bank supervises. In practice a bank runs a systematic integrity risk analysis, counters conflicts of interest, reports incidents at once, screens and monitors clients, has its organisation reviewed independently each year, keeps a compliance function, keeps deposit guarantee data current and governs outsourcing by written contract.

summaries.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Besluit Gedragstoezicht financiële ondernemingen Wft, BWBR0020421, Stb. 2006, 520, consolidated text in force from 2026-10-30

text.en: The Dutch government's decree that fills in the conduct of business rules of the Financial Supervision Act. It binds banks, credit providers, investment firms, insurers, advisers and intermediaries in their dealings with clients. In practice a bank runs a product approval process, puts set cost information and a warning in credit advertising, checks a consumer's finances and the credit register before lending, applies the mortgage norms, pays no commission on mortgage advice, issues a comparison card and handles complaints within set periods.

summaries.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Besluit bijzondere prudentiële maatregelen, beleggerscompensatie en depositogarantie Wft, BWBR0020414, Stb. 2006, 507, consolidated text in force from 2026-07-24

text.en: The Dutch government's decree on the deposit guarantee scheme, the investor compensation scheme and special prudential measures such as transfers and resolution tools. It binds banks with a Dutch licence and Dutch branches of foreign banks that take covered deposits. In practice a bank informs depositors about the guarantee, pays quarterly contributions to the Deposit Guarantee Fund while the fund is below target, pays extraordinary contributions after a payout, and gives De Nederlandsche Bank six months' notice before moving covered deposits abroad.

summaries.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Uitvoeringsbesluit Wwft 2018, BWBR0041193, Stb. 2018, 241, consolidated text in force from 2026-04-30

text.en: The Dutch government's decree that fills in the anti-money laundering act on politically exposed persons, beneficial owners and the indicators for reporting unusual transactions. It binds every institution under that act, banks included. In practice a bank treats the listed public functions, their family members and close associates as politically exposed, identifies beneficial owners by the ownership and control tests set for each type of entity, and reports to the Financial Intelligence Unit every transaction that meets the indicators set for banks.

summaries.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Besluit melding transacties financiering terrorisme, BWBR0014119, Stb. 2002, 553, consolidated text in force from 2017-07-01

text.en: A Dutch government decree under the Sanctions Act 1977 on requests for financial services that involve persons and entities on the terrorism lists it names, drawn from EU acts. It binds banks, insurers, investment firms, investment funds, insurance intermediaries, money exchangers and card issuers. In practice a bank reports every such request to the Financial Intelligence Unit with the identity and transaction data, answers the unit's follow-up questions within its deadline and keeps the report secret.

summaries.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Besluit kredietvergoeding, BWBR0005233, Stb. 1991, 549, consolidated text in force from 2024-07-01

text.en: The Dutch government's decree that sets the highest charges a lender may ask on consumer credit. It binds every credit provider that lends to consumers, banks included. In practice a bank keeps the effective annual charge on consumer credit within the statutory interest rate plus 8 percentage points, using the decree's formulas where the annual percentage rate of charge is higher, charges interest for a period only after it has ended and calculates late payment charges per day at no more than the agreed rate.

summaries.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Uitvoeringsbesluit identificatie- en rapportagevoorschriften Common Reporting Standard, BWBR0037469, Stb. 2015, 546, consolidated text in force from 2025-12-12

text.en: The Dutch government's decree that sets how reporting financial institutions identify and report accounts held by tax residents of other jurisdictions under the Common Reporting Standard. It binds reporting financial institutions, banks among them. In practice a bank obtains a self-certification when an account is opened, reviews pre-existing individual and entity accounts with the set procedures, records its steps and evidence for seven years and reports by 31 January each year.

summaries.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Uitvoeringsbesluit internationale bijstandsverlening bij de heffing van belastingen, BWBR0030973, Stb. 2011, 674, consolidated text in force from 2021-01-01

text.en: The Dutch government's decree that names who must supply data for international tax exchange and how. It binds Dutch financial institutions under the FATCA agreement with the United States and intermediaries of reportable cross-border arrangements. In practice a bank identifies US reportable accounts with the agreement's procedures, reports their data in the prescribed manner and by the set deadline, and files a reportable cross-border arrangement within 30 days.

summaries.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Uitvoeringsbesluit inkomstenbelasting 2001, BWBR0012066, Stb. 2000, 641, consolidated text in force from 2026-01-01

text.en: The Dutch government's decree that fills in the Income Tax Act 2001, including the annual data that financial institutions must supply to the tax administration. It binds banks, investment firms, funds and their managers, payment and e-money institutions, insurers and pension providers. In practice a bank reports each client's balances, interest and investment income and data on home loans every year, in the manner and by the deadline the tax inspector prescribes.

summaries.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Besluit toezicht trustkantoren 2018, BWBR0041680, Stb. 2018, 463, consolidated text in force from 2024-07-01

text.en: The Dutch government's decree that fills in the integrity and organisation rules of the Trust Offices Supervision Act 2018. It binds licensed trust offices, including those owned by banking groups. In practice a trust office analyses its integrity risks, counters conflicts of interest, screens staff in sensitive positions, classifies clients and monitors transactions, keeps a procedure manual, runs a compliance function with an annual work programme and a yearly audit kept separate from client work, and outsources only under a written contract.

summaries.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Tijdelijke regeling hypothecair krediet, BWBR0032503, Stcrt. 2012, 26433, consolidated text in force from 2026-01-01

text.en: The Dutch Minister of Finance's regulation that sets how much a lender may lend to a consumer against a home. It binds every mortgage lender, banks included. In practice a bank bases the test income on lasting income, keeps the financing costs within the percentages of the annex using at least the published average rate for short fixed periods, counts student loan instalments, documents any exceptional deviation and lends no more than 100 per cent of the home's value, or 106 per cent for energy-saving measures.

summaries.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Uitvoeringsregeling Wet ter voorkoming van witwassen en financieren van terrorisme, BWBR0024275, Stcrt. 2008, 142, consolidated text in force from 2026-01-01

text.en: The Dutch ministerial regulation that fills in the anti-money laundering act, chiefly by designating the documents on which a client's identity can be verified. It binds every institution under that act, banks included. In practice a bank verifies a natural person's identity on a passport, identity card, driving licence or one of the other designated documents, and a Dutch-based legal person's identity on a commercial register extract or a deed or statement by a lawyer or notary.

summaries.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Regeling toezicht trustkantoren 2018, BWBR0041629, Stcrt. 2018, 68147, consolidated text in force from 2025-11-25

text.en: The Dutch Minister of Finance's regulation under the Trust Offices Supervision Act 2018 that grants exemptions from the licence requirement and sets what a licence application and an incident report contain. It binds trust offices and those relying on an exemption. In practice a trust office supplies the listed data on its management, owners, structure and operations when it applies for a licence, and gives De Nederlandsche Bank the full set of details the regulation lists whenever it reports an incident.

summaries.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Uitvoeringsregeling Wft, BWBR0020537, Stcrt. 2006, 230, consolidated text in force from 2025-11-25

text.en: The Dutch Minister of Finance's regulation with technical rules under the Financial Supervision Act and its decrees, such as how the effective rate of mortgage credit is calculated, how the components of a variable mortgage rate are named, exemptions from licensing and model powers of attorney. It binds the firms each chapter names. In practice a bank that lends on mortgages names the components of a variable borrowing rate with the five labels the regulation sets.

summaries.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Regeling vakbekwaamheid werknemers beleggingsondernemingen Wft, BWBR0040497, Stcrt. 2018, 237, consolidated text in force from 2017-01-05

text.en: The Dutch Minister of Finance's regulation setting the knowledge and competence that staff of an investment firm need to inform or advise clients on investments, as MiFID II requires. It binds investment firms. In practice the firm makes sure that staff who inform clients know the products, costs, services and markets, that advisers can also judge suitability, that staff still qualifying work under a qualified colleague's supervision for at most four years, and it reviews their competence every year.

summaries.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Regeling toezicht Sanctiewet 1977, BWBR0018806, Stcrt. 2005, 188, consolidated text in force from 2014-05-09

text.en: The supervisors' regulation on how financial institutions under the Sanctions Act 1977 secure compliance with the financial sanctions. It binds the institutions the act lists, among them banks, insurers, investment firms, fund managers, pension funds, payment service providers and trust offices. In practice a bank screens its relations against the sanctions lists through its internal controls, reports any match to its supervisor at once, keeps the reports and related data until five years after the listing ends and answers the supervisor's questions.

summaries.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Regeling staten financiële ondernemingen Wft 2011, BWBR0020778, Stcrt. 2006, 249, consolidated text in force from 2025-12-03

text.en: De Nederlandsche Bank's regulation that adopts the models of the prudential reporting statements and sets how often and by when they are filed. It binds banks, investment firms, clearing institutions, payment and e-money institutions, insurers, premium pension institutions and fund managers. In practice a bank files its statements at the frequencies and deadlines of Annex 6 and the extra bank statements of Annex 6.6, also files the statements the EBA reporting standards require, values items as in its annual accounts and files consolidated statements where the law requires them.

summaries.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Regeling specifieke bepalingen CRD en CRR, BWBR0042578, Stcrt. 2019, 53011, consolidated text in force from 2026-03-06

text.en: De Nederlandsche Bank's regulation that exercises the national options and discretions of the Capital Requirements Directive and Regulation, among them the systemic risk buffer and, for less significant banks and CRR investment firms, rules on qualifying holdings, default, large exposures and stable funding. Its chapter 3 binds less significant Dutch banks and CRR investment firms. In practice such a bank risk-weights large non-financial holdings at 1,250 per cent, applies the 90-day default rule with the set threshold and documents large exposure exemptions.

summaries.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Regeling beheerst beloningsbeleid Wft 2021, BWBR0045660, Stcrt. 2021, 42301, consolidated text in force from 2021-10-19

text.en: The regulation of De Nederlandsche Bank and the Authority for the Financial Markets that sets the remuneration policy principles of the Capital Requirements Directive, the Investment Firms Directive and IORP II for Dutch firms. It binds banks, investment firms and premium pension institutions. In practice a bank applies its policy to all staff with a material impact on its risk profile, has the supervisory function adopt it and an independent review each year, pays half of variable pay in instruments, defers at least 40 per cent, applies malus and has a remuneration committee if significant.

summaries.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Regeling Oversight goede werking betalingsverkeer, BWBR0037381, Stcrt. 2015, 46628, consolidated text in force from 2022-06-25

text.en: De Nederlandsche Bank's regulation on the proper functioning of retail payments in the Netherlands. It binds banks, payment institutions and e-money institutions with their seat in the Netherlands that carry out 120 million or more giro retail transactions a year. In practice such a bank keeps a sound legal basis and clear governance for its retail payment services, manages their operational risks with systems that ensure high availability and security, and publishes at least monthly how available its time-critical payment services were.

summaries.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Rapportagevoorschriften betalingsbalansrapportages 2022 (RV 2022), BWBR0045658, Stcrt. 2021, 42097, consolidated text in force from 2026-01-01

text.en: De Nederlandsche Bank's rules for the data residents report to compile the Netherlands' balance of payments. They bind every resident the Bank designates as a reporter, among them banks, insurers, pension funds, investment funds and crypto-asset service providers. In practice a bank reports under its assigned profiles monthly or quarterly within the set number of days, keeps its registration details current, keeps its reports for at least three years and supplies the extra foreign asset data and further information the Bank asks for through its portal.

summaries.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Regeling afgeschermde rekeningen Wft, BWBR0020672, Stcrt. 2006, 244, consolidated text in force from 2018-10-13

text.en: De Nederlandsche Bank's regulation on shielded accounts, where a client's identity is hidden in transaction processing behind a number or code word while the bank knows who the client is. It binds banks and bank branches in the Netherlands. In practice a bank opens such accounts only under a restrictive policy to protect a client's privacy and security or to prevent insider dealing, instructs its staff, and keeps a central register of them under internal control that its compliance unit can access.

summaries.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Nadere regeling gedragstoezicht financiële ondernemingen Wft, BWBR0020540, Stcrt. 2006, 233, consolidated text in force from 2023-04-01

text.en: The Authority for the Financial Markets' further rules on conduct of business under the Financial Supervision Act, chiefly on the form of warnings and information in advertising and on the comparison card. It binds credit providers, offerors of complex products, financial service providers and investment firms. In practice a bank shows the credit warning in the set form in credit advertising, shows the risk indicator in advertising for complex products, draws up comparison cards in the set model and puts the two set risk sentences in investment advertising.

summaries.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Beperkingen aan CFD’s, BWBR0042122, Stcrt. 2019, 21123, consolidated text in force from 2019-04-19

text.en: A binding product intervention decision of the Authority for the Financial Markets under MiFIR that restricts the sale of contracts for differences to retail clients. It binds every firm that markets, distributes or sells CFDs, banks included. In practice a provider requires the set initial margin, closes positions out at half of it, limits the client's losses to the account funds, offers no trading incentives and shows a risk warning with its own share of loss-making retail accounts in every communication.

summaries.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Besluit beperkingen aan turbo’s, BWBR0045359, Stcrt. 2021, 34416, consolidated text in force from 2021-10-01

text.en: A binding product intervention decision of the Authority for the Financial Markets under MiFIR that restricts the sale of turbos to retail clients in the Netherlands. It binds the investment firms that market, distribute or sell turbos, banks included. In practice a provider quotes no ask price for a turbo above the maximum leverage for its underlying, offers no trading incentives, shows a risk warning with its own share of loss-making retail clients and reports another provider's breach of the leverage limit.
